title: Ok for kids pancakes.
text: Ok for kids pancakes.. The pan is cute. The first times it was really non stick even without butter or cooking oil spray but now even I don't put the butter, pancakes stick (I have always washed by hand). The idea is nice, but you really need to be careful with the amount of dough otherwise it will go over and mess up. The pancakes are small and thin but that's ok for kids and the animal shape is very cute.
